    Projects

    TelemetryGuard

    Built a C++17 CLI that runs 28 diagnostics on flight telemetry and returns a GO, MONITOR, or HOLD decision.

    Would you give it a GO?

    Move a reading and watch the satellite’s readiness change.

    GO

    GO — All three readings are within the demo limits.

    A simplified interactive illustration inspired by TelemetryGuard. The C++ project runs 28 diagnostics; this demo uses three sample rules.

    First Guess ↘
    Which reading grounded the sample flight?

    The missing fuel level triggered HOLD. The temperature exceeded its warning limit.

    FirstPay

    Built an interactive app for comparing job offers, estimating take-home pay, and exploring budgets and health plans.

    First Guess ↘
    Which sample offer leaves more money each month after recurring costs?

    Offer A leaves $1,814 a month, compared with $1,338 for Offer B. This is the app’s ongoing monthly cushion using the full sample inputs.

    FrameWatch

    Built a C11 decoder that detects corrupt binary telemetry frames, missing sequence numbers, and out-of-range sensor readings.

    First Guess ↘
    The decoder received frames 1, 2, and 4. Where did the stream skip a frame?

    Frame 3 is missing. The decoder also flags frame 4 because its sensor reading exceeds the sample threshold.

    See the actual decoder output →
    Run the sample ↗
    ALERT sensor=4 sequence=4 value=130
frames=3 valid=3 corrupt=0 missing_sequences=1 regressions=0 threshold_alerts=1
    View repository ↗
